question: How many Indian states share their border with Sikkim?
solution:
The correct answer is__** One.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Sikkim may be a rare state which only connects with one state of the country. the sole state of India that connects to Sikkim is West Bengal while other borders of Sikkim connect with countries like Nepal
